main.description: Opt-in record for the lastnpcalex.agency game. One record per repo, always at rkey `self` (upsert semantics: the YES/NO page overwrites it via com.atproto.repo.putRecord). Absence of the record means the account has never been asked.

playerCharacter.description: 1 = opted in: the account is a player character in the game. 0 = explicitly opted out.

handle.description: Optional denormalized handle at opt-in time, for human readability in raw record listings.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent yes/no choice.
